newsitem.title: USA: Amylin raises $31.2 mln from stock sales.
newsitem.headline: Amylin raises $31.2 mln from stock sales.

text.p: Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc. said it expects to raise $31.2 million through a combination of public and private stock offerings.
The company has priced a public offer of 1.75 million shares of common stock at $10.00 per share which will net $16.2 million. Executive officers and directors will purchase $900,000 of the shares.
Separately, it plans to sell 1.5 million shares to Johnson & Johnson unit, Johnson & Johnson Development Corp, with whom Amylin collaborates on a drug called pramlintide.
The sale results from Amylin's first milestone achievement in their collaboration and will net the company $15 million.

Proceeds from the stock sales will be used to fund the ongoing development of pramlintide, including the Phase III efficacy studies, to expand other research and development programs and for other corporate purposes.
